title: Submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water bubbles -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='22' r='3' fill='#7fd8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='14' r='2' fill='#7fd8ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='18' r='2.5' fill='#7fd8ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='28' r='1.8' fill='#7fd8ff' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- propeller -->
  <rect x='76' y='46' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='42' rx='2.5' ry='7' fill='#ffd76e'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='54' rx='2.5' ry='7' fill='#ffd76e'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ff9f2e'/>

  <!-- main submarine body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='48' rx='34' ry='18' fill='#ffcf3d'/>
  <!-- lighter top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='42' rx='28' ry='10' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- lower fin -->
  <path d='M28 64 L38 64 L34 72 Z' fill='#e8a91e'/>
  <path d='M52 64 L62 64 L58 72 Z' fill='#e8a91e'/>

  <!-- periscope -->
  <rect x='42' y='22' width='6' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ff9f2e'/>
  <rect x='40' y='20' width='12' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- periscope lens -->
  <circle cx='49' cy='22' r='2' fill='#52d6ff'/>

  <!-- portholes -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='48' r='6' fill='#2e8b8b'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='48' r='4' fill='#52d6ff'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='48' r='2' fill='#bff4ff'/>

  <circle cx='48' cy='48' r='6' fill='#2e8b8b'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='48' r='4' fill='#52d6ff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='48' r='2' fill='#bff4ff'/>

  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='6' fill='#2e8b8b'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='4' fill='#52d6ff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='2' fill='#bff4ff'/>

  <!-- front window / nose -->
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='48' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#2e8b8b'/>
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='48' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#52d6ff'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#bff4ff'/>

  <!-- small yellow stripes -->
  <rect x='40' y='58' width='16' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e8a91e'/>
  <rect x='38' y='36' width='18' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e8a91e'/>

  <!-- little fish friend -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='32' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#ff7b54'/>
  <polygon points='16,32 12,28 12,36' fill='#ff7b54'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='31' r='1' fill='#4a1c1c'/>
</svg>
